name: Grapnelhasp
description: Sets the feet wide and the hooked tip forward so the body is ready to drag at the first contact.

name: Hookneck Scorer
description: Lays the inner curve on the forearm and draws it back, cutting the sleeve and skin together.

name: Gripping Hookhilt
description: Hooks the guard of an enemy sword and tugs once, then steps behind the loosened blade.

name: Grapnelprop
description: Taps the tip against an incoming edge and lets it rebound into a ready line.

name: Tethering Twistaway
description: Sinks qi into the wrists and pulls a hooked blade past the body, tearing it from the opponent's grip.

name: Harsh Hookguard
description: Snaps the barbed tip over the opponent's cut and drives it back into the cutter's own hand.

name: Hooktip Screen
description: Draws a straight guard line from shoulder to hip with the blade, giving every cut a fixed angle to land on.

name: Snarl Curl
description: Skips the lead foot up while the hooked end sweeps the ground, catching any trailing foot.

name: Snarlscorer
description: Raps the pommel spike to the ribs and follows at once with the barbed tip to the same side.

name: Dense Hookspine
description: Brushes a descending sword away with the blade edge and the free hand held behind it.

name: Swordhook Carapace
description: Holds the breath and presses qi into the crescent guard until it stops a heavy cut dead.

name: Snarlhasp
description: Slaps the guard blade across an opponent's hilt hand, forcing the grip open and the point wide.

name: Hookcurve Buckle
description: Offers the hooked tip as bait at wrist height, drawing a strike the stance is already set to meet.

name: Cleatthwack
description: Rolls the hook around the wrist and slices through the tendon on the pull.

name: Scudding Hookcrook
description: Sways the torso back over the planted hook so a cut passes under the chin.

name: Clevisbarrier
description: Turns on the heel and flicks the tip outward to send a thrust past the ribs.

name: Entangling Hookend
description: Presses the free palm on the spine and hooks the enemy's blade away, a plain disarm for early Seniors.

name: Rude Cresthook
description: Traps an incoming wrist in the bend and sends qi down the curve to cut as the blade is pulled.

name: Fierce Pulldown
description: Turns the parry's rebound straight into a cut at the neck, faster than the opponent can recover.

name: Rigid Hookspine
description: Drops into a low stance with the hooked tip held behind the lead calf as a hidden snare.

name: Hooklock Glide
description: Slides along the enemy blade's length into close range with the hooked end pressed to it.

name: Honed Hookneck
description: Turns the edge over the opponent's blade and cuts the wrist behind it in one motion.

name: Grapnelbarrier
description: Blocks a thrust with the barbed tip held close and steers it a hand's breadth wide.

name: Spliceyank
description: Locks the hook round the hilt and squeezes, forcing the opponent's hand to hold on or release.

name: Staticdisarm
description: Rolls the hooked end over the top of a guard and lands the tip on the forehead line.

name: Sprig Hookcrook
description: Feeds qi into the hooked bend so it grips a blade like a clamp and will not slip off.

name: Comet Cresthook
description: Snares the guard hand's blade, then drives the point through the opening into the unprotected side.

name: Regimen Hookend
description: Holds the sword low and wide against a shield user, waiting for the rim to rise.

name: Yankscreen
description: Hooks behind a shield rim and tugs it outward, breaking the holder's line of cover.

name: Brass Twistaway
description: Drives the point low beneath the shield's belly into the shin once the board is lifted.

name: Grit Hookguard
description: Slips the hooked tip out from a trapped press and steps off to the open side.

name: Hum Hooktip
description: Hooks the shield rim with qi in the wrists and wrenches the board aside, laying the carrier open.

name: Brasscleat
description: Chops down on the top edge of a held shield with qi, splitting wood and biting the arm behind it.

name: Bracing Hookhilt
description: Stands with a hook sword in each hand and the two guards crossed over the chest.

name: Claysnarl
description: Pins an enemy blade with the left hook while the right hook cuts at the exposed arm.

name: Padded Swordhook
description: Crosses both guard blades above the head and braces to take a falling blow.

name: Pirouetting Pulldown
description: Takes a wide stride on level ground, hooks held out to either side to keep the gap.

name: Stamp Hooklock
description: Hooks and releases an enemy blade with each hand in turn, never letting it settle.

name: Sleet Yank
description: Closes both hooks on one enemy limb like shears and cuts inward as the qi-driven wrists snap shut.

name: Moment Hookcurve
description: Lays one hook over the other and drives a stream of cuts forward, pressing the enemy backward.

name: Shardclevis
description: Sets the sword across the body with the hook trailing so each stroke can flow into the next.

name: Disarmscorer
description: Draws the curve upward along a limb and swings it over to chop down on the same line.

name: Snarlzip
description: Chains two short steps, right then left, around the sword so the cuts never lose their footing.

name: Grapnelbuckle
description: Turns the hook over an incoming blade and returns along the same path with a quick riposte.

name: Regimen Hookneck
description: Braces the open hand on the hilt ring and leans into a shove, holding the line.

name: Brass Yank
description: Chains three beats of tip, curve and spike in one fast run.

name: Sleet Pulldown
description: Carries one breath through a bind and a slice so both land before the opponent can answer.

name: Lurching Hookguard
description: Throws hooking strokes in a running chain, each cutting from a new angle to keep the foe moving back.

name: Resolute Hookhilt
description: Turns an opponent's blade away with the hook and spins the point into the ribs on the return.

name: Sleet Hookend
description: Lowers the hips and extends the hooked tip near the ground, hunting for a leg to catch.

name: Sprig Yank
description: Hooks the heel of an advancing foot and tugs sharply back, spilling the foe forward.

name: Swordhook Scorer
description: Sweeps the inner edge low across the calf as the opponent steps, cutting the muscle.

name: Rill Hooktip
description: Steps back in a feigned stumble, drawing a hasty overreach onto the waiting hooked tip.

name: Yankbuckle
description: Hooks behind a thigh, lifts with the hip and throws the opponent over the planted foot.

name: Sleet Cresthook
description: Drags an ensnared leg along the ground behind the sword until the opponent falls and cannot rise.

name: Sleetcleat
description: Takes a tempering breath behind the crescent guard so qi can settle before the next exchange.

name: Rugged Hookcurve
description: Thrusts the crescent guard forward like a small knife, cutting the arm that crowds the hilt.

name: Rill Cresthook
description: Rolls an enemy edge down the crescent guard and out past the hip.

name: Brawn Disarm
description: Slips half a pace forward inside a thrust, close enough for the guard to bite.

name: Cramping Twistaway
description: Jabs the guard tip at a wrist and hooks it with the barb on the way back.

name: Brass Hookspine
description: Sends qi into the crescent guard so its small edge bites cleanly through leather and cloth.

name: Clevisscreen
description: Pinches an enemy blade between guard and tip, then tears it sideways out of line.
